senses.definition: A colourless non-aged alcoholic liquor made by distilling fermented grains such as barley, corn, oats or rye with juniper berries; the base for many cocktails.
(poker) Drawing the best card or combination of cards.
examples: Johnny Chan held jack-nine, and hit gin when a queen-ten-eight board was dealt out.

senses.definition: (obsolete) A trick; a device or instrument.
(obsolete) A scheme; contrivance; artifice; a figurative trap or snare.
